caseNameFull: Walker v. County School Board of Brunswick County, Virginia
attorneys: Jack Greenberg, James M. Nabrit III, William Bennett Turner, S. W. Tucker, and Henry L. Marsh III for petitioners. Frederick T. Gray for respondents.

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
